title: Pandara
description: Enhance your multiplayer experience with this optimized Fabric pack. Features Simple Voice Chat, EmoteCraft animations, and Xaero’s Minimap, delivering better stability and visuals without compromising performance.
body:
🐼 Welcome to Pandara.fun Modpack

A clean and optimized Fabric collection designed for smooth gameplay and better social interaction.

✨ Key Features:

🚀 Optimized Performance: Runs smoothly even on low-end PCs thanks to modern optimization mods.

🗣️ Voice Chat: Stay connected with friends using Simple Voice Chat.

💃 Express Yourself: Use EmoteCraft to add life to your character with custom animations.

🗺️ Navigation: Never get lost with Xaero’s Minimap.

Perfect for playing on Pandara.fun or in singleplayer!
